accepted_cycle: Both signed disjoint gradients, fixed evaluation passes, independent local replay and selection on each physical node, durable round/cursor commit
continuity_test: Restart a process while work or replication is pending, verify identical cursor/lineage and eventual completion without a duplicated optimizer step
evaluation: Repeated development EVAL128/57123 next-byte predictions; not a fresh blind test or general chat certification
interruption: Resume the persisted round, including a candidate selected locally before the second PC adopted it
pause: Cancel active work and preserve pending contributions, candidate and cursor
quotas: Existing per-machine CPU/RAM/disk/network consent remains unchanged; the store cap is subordinate to that consent
rejected_cycle: Fixed evaluation fails; retain old selected state and record result/cost, then consume the assigned training range
replay: CPU child reconstructs received state from the exact signed gradients and parent AdamW moments before adoption
replica_transport: Native swarm.artifact over public encrypted LSP only; VPN administrative code and compact metadata only
scope: Bounded known-operator native own-model scheduling, evaluated adoption and two-PC replication; not open consensus or learned metabolism
shards: Two disjoint 128-document ranges per round, starting at TRAIN[256]; no epoch wrap
transport_failure: Preserve pending work, retry after bounded backoff; do not count a quality rejection or advance cursor
